scan.title: Scan code
scan.hint: Hold the QR code or barcode inside the frame
scan.mismatch: The scanned code is not what this step expects:

ocr.title: Read value from photo
ocr.valueHint: Compare with the display and correct any digit that is wrong.
ocr.lowConfidence: Low confidence — check every digit against the display.
ocr.edited: This value differs from what was recognised. Make sure it matches the display.
ocr.noReading: No number could be recognised. Retake the photo, or close this and type the value into the field.
ocr.unavailable: Reading numbers from photos is not available on this device. Type the value in manually.
ocr.failed: The value could not be read. Close this and type the value into the field.
ocr.tooManyDecimals: At most {n} decimal places — the value is never rounded.

errors.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access for StepTrack in the browser or system settings, then try again.
errors.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
errors.cameraBusy: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using the camera and try again.
errors.insecureContext: The camera only works over a secure (https) connection.
errors.scannerUnsupported: Scanning is not supported on this device. Type the code instead.
errors.scannerModuleUnavailable: The Google barcode scanner module is not installed yet. Connect to the internet once so it can be downloaded.
errors.scannerModuleFailed: The Google barcode scanner module could not be installed. Check the connection and Google Play services.
errors.noPreview: The scanner preview could not be shown.
errors.ocrUnavailable: Reading numbers from photos is not available on this device. Type the value in manually.
errors.ocrFailed: The value could not be read from the photo. Type it in manually.
errors.imageUnreadable: The photo could not be read. Please take it again.
errors.cameraFailed: The camera could not take a photo.
errors.scanFailed: Scanning failed. Try again or type the code.

app.offlineReady: StepTrack is ready to work offline.
app.updateAvailable: A new version of StepTrack is available.
app.updateHint: Finish the current step first — updating reloads the app. Recorded data is kept.
app.configError: StepTrack is not configured correctly: {detail}. Contact your administrator.
